evidence_frontier: Exp021 showed a w8 compression candidate (4,278 parameters) achieving 887 aggregate Q.ANT correct predictions on ECG200 test set, exactly 10 fewer than the w16 Alpha5 control (897). The next preregistered step is to confirm whether this w8 boundary is reproducible using integer‑count gating on a fresh seed set.
analysis: - Exp020 promoted Alpha5 (w16) after meeting aggregate correct >=893 and logit MAE reduction. - Exp021 evaluated w8 and w12 candidates against the w16 control on the same train/test split, reporting aggregate correct counts (w8:887, w12:884, control:897). - The reviewer rejected the draft because it deviated from the preregistered confirmation design (exact seeds, 50 epochs, same relative gate). - No experiment has yet tested the w8 candidate on an independent seed set; therefore reproducibility of the 10‑prediction gap remains unverified.
hypothesis: When trained and evaluated on ECG200 using a fresh preregistered set of random seeds, the w8 local‑width candidate will achieve an aggregate Q.ANT correct count that is no more than 10 fewer than the w16 Alpha5 control, reproducing the boundary observed in Exp021.

proposal.title: Confirmation of w8 Local‑Width Boundary on ECG200
proposal.research_question: Is the 10‑prediction aggregate correct gap between the w8 compression candidate and the w16 Alpha5 control reproducible on a fresh seed set?
proposal.rationale: Confirming the w8 boundary is essential before exploring narrower widths. Reproducibility on independent seeds validates that the observed trade‑off between model size and accuracy is not a one‑off artifact of a particular random initialization.

procedure: Generate a preregistered list of 5 distinct random seeds (e.g., 42, 123, 256, 512, 1024).
For each seed, train the w8 candidate (4,278 parameters) on the ECG200 training set (100 samples) for exactly 50 epochs using the same hyper‑parameters as Exp021.
For each seed, train the w16 control (Alpha5, 8,550 parameters) under identical conditions.
After training, evaluate both models on the ECG200 test set (100 samples) and record the number of correct Q.ANT predictions per seed.
Sum correct predictions across the 5 seeds for each model (max 500).

success_criteria.aggregate_gate: candidate_correct >= control_correct - 10 on the combined 5 × 100 predictions (denominator 500).

proposal.risks:
- Over‑fitting to the small ECG200 training set could inflate accuracy on some seeds.
- Random seed selection bias; using only 5 seeds may not capture full variability.
- Software‑simulation noise may cause slight deviations from the exact 10‑prediction gap.
